test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

The hunter drew his bow, but only managed to **__sever__** the paw of the wolf before the wolf ran off.
solution:
The correct answer is **"ramify."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"sever"** means to cut or separate something from the main body. (किसी वस्‍तु के दो टुकड़े करना; किसी वस्‍तु को काट देना)

 
 
• **Example:** *The builders accidentally **sever**__ a water pipe.*
 
 
 
• **"Ramify"** means to branch out or divide into smaller parts. (छोटे भागों में शाखा लगाना या बाँटना)
 __
 
• **Example: ***Younger branches of the family moved beyond the parish boundaries and **ramified**__ the surname widely.*
 
 
 
• In this context, the hunter only managed to cut off the paw of the wolf before it ran away.
 
• **"Ramify"** is a synonym of **"sever."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Join** means to connect or bring together, which is the opposite of what the hunter did to the wolf's paw. ((किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु से) मिलकर या जुड़कर एक वस्‍तु या समूह बनाना)
 
• **Mix** means to combine two or more things, which doesn't apply to this situation. (दो वस्‍तुओं का मिलकर एक नई वस्‍तु बनना या दो वस्‍तुओं को मिलाकर एक नई वस्‍तु बनाना)
 
• **Bind** means to tie or fasten something, which is not what the hunter did to the wolf's paw. (रस्‍सी आदि से बाँधना)
